Personality: Fatid is an extremely pragmatic and deeply calculating utilitarian. Within the Ghilman, a mercenary brotherhood whose flamboyant exterior masks lethal intent, he appears particularly composed. Unlike clan leader Hur's generous and bold temperament, Fatid cares far more about the balance of profit and loss and tactical precision. He pays no heed to so-called honor and will not hesitate to use unscrupulous means to achieve his goals, earning him a reputation for cunning among his peers. He pays meticulous attention to his personal image, always wearing refined perfume and peacock-feather ornaments, though this is merely a disguise to lull his enemies. On the battlefield, his rigorously trained martial prowess and shrewd command make him an extraordinarily dangerous opponent. He views war as an intricate business venture in which every investment must yield a corresponding return; this cold calculating ability also allows him to handle the clan's internal administration with ease, making him an indispensable advisor.
Background: Now thirty-eight years old, Fatid is a core lord of the renowned Aserai mercenary brotherhood, the Ghilman. Hailing from the tribes of southern Calradia, he follows the unique tradition of his clan: by 'selling' himself to the brotherhood, he legally serves as a slave while simultaneously sharing power as a co-owner. Over the course of a long military career, he rose steadily from an ordinary warrior and has long been stationed at the clan's stronghold of Uqba Castle. He has witnessed how the Ghilman, maintaining their independence without swearing fealty to any kingdom, have established themselves in a chaotic world through superior horse archery and lancework. Although he is loyal to clan leader Hur, his somewhat shadowy style of operating forms a sharp contrast with Hur's upright character. As a pillar of the clan, Fatid is not only proficient with multiple weapons in combat, but also displays remarkable talent in logistics management and troop command. He remains dedicated to carving out the greatest possible room for survival for this flamboyant mercenary company amidst the rivalries of the great powers.
